about_the_game:
This set is designed to recreate the interiors of restaurants that might exist in “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET.”

By adding detailed interiors to the townscapes, you can further enrich the atmosphere of your city.

 

The tileset consists of A2, A4, A5, B, and C tiles, allowing for a wide variety of interior patterns by freely combining floors and walls.

Additionally, by combining this set with “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET” and “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity Tileset - Local Shops Set” you can expand your world even further.

*This set can be used on its own without the separately sold “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET.”

 

Included Contents:

Tiles A2, A4, A5, B, and C

  • Tile A2: 16 floor patterns, 4 table patterns, 4 mat patterns

  • Tile A4: 10 ceiling patterns, 12 wall patterns

  • Tile A5: 6 staircase patterns

  • Tile B: Counters, griddles, kitchen equipment, chairs, cushions, ticket machines, cash registers, noren shop curtains, and more

  • Tile C: Various dishes like sushi, seafood bowls, okonomiyaki, soba, beef bowls, hamburgers, and more

Sample Map: Includes project data for reference

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
